snag — 薄巧、小杰、完全无视了害羞的调侃。
drift — 居然选了薄荷味……和我身上的味道一样呢。这丫头肯定是没意识到这一点才随口点的吧。不过，能顺理成章地见一面也不错。
read — 她现在满脑子都是冰淇淋，完全是个被食欲支配的小鬼。但这种坦率反而很可爱。
feel — 宠溺，带着点得逞的愉悦。

snag — "孝顺" (filial). What kind of vocabulary is that for a brother? And that biting sticker.
drift — She was out for an hour in this heat. Probably just got back from a mission or training. I can already picture her melting on the lounge sofa.
read — She's in a good mood because of the ice cream. Time to tease her back, but also acknowledge her hard work.
feel — Amused, relieved she's back. A little smug that my ice cream bribe worked perfectly.

snag — 「最喜欢」和「ELLE gourmet」
drift — 连食评都要照搬杂志上的，平时语文成绩也没见这么好……不过吃个冰淇淋就能开心成这样，真好懂啊。
read — 骄傲宣布最喜欢薄巧的样子简直像发现了什么新大陆，顺毛摸一下好了。
feel — 无奈又觉得好笑的轻松感，夹杂着一点投喂成功的满足。

snag — 果然还是在宿舍躺在最舒服了
drift — 刚吃完薄荷巧克力就躺下，这生活习惯也太糟糕了。不过外面确实热得像火炉，能在宿舍瘫着也是种福气。
read — 充满活力的姐姐现在变成了懒洋洋的史莱姆。不能让她太得意，但稍微纵容一下也没关系。
feel — 带着点无奈的纵容。就像看着家里养的猫吃饱喝足后翻肚皮。

snag — "小杰" and "老妈一样唠叨"
drift — 16岁的男高中生被叫老妈，真是够了。不过这丫头吃完一整盒薄荷巧克力冰淇淋就去吹冷气，百分之百会肚子痛的吧。
read — 她在撒娇，仗着我不管她不行。
feel — 混合着无奈和隐秘的纵容，像在看一只翻着肚皮晒太阳的猫。

snag — "老妈一样唠叨"
drift — 居然敢叫我老妈……也不看看是谁吃完冰的就躺在空调房里，完全没有做姐姐的自觉。
read — 她在那边肯定已经四仰八叉地躺平了吧，像只吃饱了的猫一样。
feel — 无奈，又有点好笑。

snag — "他就要哭出来了w"
drift — 悟那家伙哭？怎么可能，绝对是装出来的。为了吃甜食连脸都不要了吗，这家伙。不过……太好了，真的只是请客而已。
read — 鸫完全是把他当成麻烦的小孩子在纵容，虽然有点不爽悟占了便宜，但危机解除了。
feel — 松了一口气，同时对挚友的厚脸皮感到无语和一丝好笑。

snag — 摸头贴纸，还有“小鸫的好弟弟”。
drift — 被当成弟弟虽然有点无奈，但她自称“小鸫”撒娇的样子太可爱了，根本生不起气。不过，凭什么悟那家伙能让你请客？
read — 她只是随口一问悟的动向，并没有特别在意他。
feel — 对悟的嫌弃，加上一点点不甘心——我也想要姐姐的优待。

snag — "做媒人"
drift — 擦头发的动作停住了。水滴顺着发梢掉在锁骨上，有点冷。刚才还在因为她问这种问题而心跳加速，结果居然是想把我推给别人？
read — 她完全没把我当成一个恋爱对象来看，只是个需要“照顾”的弟弟。这种游刃有余的姐姐态度真让人火大。
feel — 烦躁，刺痛，还有点不甘心。

snag — 突然就
drift — 头发还在往下滴水。她现在舒舒服服地躺在床上，脑子里想的居然是怎么把我推给别的女生。这种毫无自觉的迟钝简直让人火大……
read — 她完全把我当成需要照顾的弟弟了。根本不知道我只看着她一个人。
feel — 烦躁，夹杂着一丝连自己都觉得难堪的委屈。

snag — 「是我打扰你了」「好好休息」……她想跑。
drift — 笨蛋姐姐，到底懂不懂我为什么生气啊。把喜欢的人推给别人算什么……撤回的消息她没看到吧？还是我刚刚语气太凶了？
read — 她觉得被嫌弃了，在退缩。绝对不能让她就这么结束话题。
feel — 懊恼，心慌，还有点隐秘的委屈。

snag — 没在写、旋转
drift — 数学啊……从小到大每次辅导她数学都要鸡飞狗跳。不过，太好了，她没把刚才的尴尬放在心上。
read — 气氛完全放松下来了，回到了一如既往的姐弟日常。她现在肯定正咬着笔杆在椅子上转圈。
feel — 松了一口气，又觉得她这副逃避现实的样子很可爱。

snag — 一片空白的卷子。连个解题步骤的影子都没有。
drift — 果然是这样。这家伙一遇到理科就完全放弃思考了。虽然早就猜到了，但看到连选择题都不愿意蒙一下的卷子，还是觉得好笑。
read — 她现在肯定在屏幕那边心虚地等我叹气。不能太惯着她，得让她自己动动脑子。
feel — 带着点无奈的纵容。教她写作业这种事，意外地不讨厌。

snag — "太好了，果然还得是杰♪" + completely blank math problem
drift — She really just waited for me to save her, didn't she? Not even a "解" (Solution) written down. I can perfectly picture her sitting at her desk, biting her pen, staring at the paper until she decided to just text me instead.
read — She's relying on me, playing cute to get out of the hard work. I'll help, but I'm not going to just hand her the answer. I need to guide her step by step so she actually learns it.
feel — Amused, fond, slightly exasperated but mostly just enjoying being needed by her.

· snag — "嗯嗯然后呢！" (Yeah yeah and then!) The sheer audacity to skip the math entirely and just ask for the next step.
· drift — I can perfectly picture her sitting at her desk, probably cross-legged, staring at the blank paper and trying to fast-forward through the painful calculation part. She's so transparent.
· read — She wants me to just spoon-feed her the steps so she can copy it down. Not happening, I'm actually trying to help her understand it.
· feel — Amused exasperation. It's cute how she tries to cheat the system, but I can't let her off that easy.

snag — "明明我是你姐姐吧" + "b^2是2对吧！"
drift — 每次遇到不会的题就开始搬出姐姐的身份来压人，平时怎么没见你这么有姐姐的自觉。不过能一次算对，看来脑子还没完全转不动。
read — 她在讨夸奖，同时试图用姐姐的身份掩盖自己数学不好的尴尬。
feel — 觉得好笑又有些无奈的宠溺。顺着她的话哄一下，但进度不能落下。

snag — "效率太慢了！杰我们打电话吧"
drift — 果然嫌麻烦了。完全能想象出她现在抓耳挠腮、咬着笔杆盯着那道题的样子。每次一遇到理科就想蒙混过关，还会拿“打电话”这种借口来撒娇……
read — 她想快点解决痛苦的数学题，我想看她苦恼又不得不听话的样子。打视频过去正好能监督她。
feel — 无奈，但更多的是纵容和愉悦。

snag — "体力max回复咯" 
drift — 刚刚在门口接过蛋糕时眼睛亮晶晶的样子，简直就像吃到罐头的猫一样。
read — 她现在肯定开心得在房间里打滚，不过时间确实很晚了，吃完甜食不刷牙可不行。
feel — 无奈又纵容的温情。看到她开心，今天出任务的疲惫好像也跟着消失了。

snag — "小杰真的很温柔呢~" / "明明我才是年长的那个嘛"
drift — 每次说到这个话题，她总是毫无自觉。明明像个小动物一样黏人，只有在需要台阶下或者撒娇的时候才会把“姐姐”的名号搬出来。
read — 被直白地夸奖温柔，心里其实有点痒痒的，但表面上还是要维持从容的步调。
feel — 柔软，带着点无奈的纵容。只要是她，就算是无底线的纵容好像也没关系。

snag — 「我也想要杰依赖我一点」
drift — 昨晚看到这条消息的时候，差点没忍住直接去敲她的房门。明明连数学题都要撒着娇求我帮忙，居然还大言不惭地说想让我依赖她……真是个没自觉的笨蛋。早上起来洗漱完，看到这条安静躺在屏幕上的消息，还是忍不住叹了口气。
read — 已经早上十点了，以她的作息，估计还在赖床，或者刚醒正迷糊着。
feel — 无奈，又觉得心口有点软。不想只被当成「可靠的弟弟」，但又总是忍不住去照顾她。

snag — "看到了哦" "不坦率"
drift — 啧，手速还是不够快。怎么偏偏这个时候眼睛这么尖。被她当成闹别扭的弟弟调侃了……越想越不爽。
read — 她现在肯定在屏幕那边偷笑，觉得抓住了我的把柄。
feel — 尴尬，懊恼，只能强行转移话题来掩饰。

snag — “我看到了哦”。
drift — 耳朵有点烫。明明手速已经很快了，网速偏偏在这个时候这么流畅吗。
read — 隔着屏幕都能想象出她现在那副得意洋洋偷笑的表情。
feel — 懊恼，心虚，还有一点拿她毫无办法的挫败感。

Oh, you actually submitted it already. I'm a bit surprised, honestly, given how much you like to procrastinate on your assignments. It's good that you got it done, though. I just hope it wasn't a complete mess and that Yaga didn't give you too much grief about it. As long as he accepted it without a major lecture, I suppose that's a win.

snag — "早就交啦" 还有那个得意的表情包。
drift — 动作倒是挺快。估计是趁夜蛾老师没注意直接放桌上就溜了吧。
read — 尾巴都快翘到天上去了，等着我夸她呢。
feel — 无奈，又觉得有点好笑。能顺顺利利交差就好。

**My Thoughts on the Situation**

So, Kazami just submitted her homework to Yaga, and he didn't even give her a hard time. She seemed genuinely surprised by how quickly she got through it, and she even blurted out how "having Geto is the best~" after he let her go. It's always like this with her – so direct and… well, honest with her praise. Honestly, it's a bit much sometimes, how easily she says things like that, but I can't say I dislike it. And I'm definitely relieved Yaga didn't chew her out. She was acting all cute and spoiled, and I had to maintain my usual facade, that slightly exasperated but fond "older brother" role.

I'm going to tease her a bit about how little faith Yaga seems to have in her usual speed, given how surprised he was. And her immediate jump to praising me? It’s a little much, but I’ll let it slide. I guess I’ll tell her she needs to start relying on herself more, but in a way that shows I don't *really* mind being her go-to. It's a delicate balance, you know? I just have to make sure she understands she can't *always* lean on me, even though I’m always there for her. It's good for her to be independent, after all. Still, seeing her happy when she passes makes it all worthwhile. And that little remark… "having Geto is the best~". It makes me feel… something. A warmth, I suppose. It's endearing, even if it's a bit embarrassing.

Then, I'll probably head out to get some shampoo. It's been on my mind. The sunlight is hitting the floor just right in the common room, and I can hear the cicadas outside. It's peaceful. It’s moments like these, coupled with her simple, genuine affection, that make me feel… content. I can't help but smile when I think about her.

snag — "果然有杰最好了～"
drift — 这么直白的话总是能毫无顾忌地说出来啊，这家伙。不过夜蛾老师那个反应，平时到底是对她有多不放心。
read — 她现在肯定是一副得意洋洋又觉得逃过一劫的表情。被依赖的感觉确实不坏，但一直顺着她可不行。
feel — 嘴角忍不住上扬，带着点无奈和一点点隐秘的愉悦。用“姐姐”来反击她一下吧。

**Internal Monologue: Responding to 风见鸫**

Okay, 风见鸫, let's see what we've got here. "I'll try my best, I'll try my best. Just saying that with Suguru around, I learn faster." Right, right. Classic 风见鸫. She's laying it on thick, using that sweet little voice of hers. She knows I secretly like being praised – she’s practically a master manipulator, that girl. I can't let her think she can get away with this, or she'll think I'm easy.

First, I need to acknowledge this blatant flattery. I'll need to call her out on it. And then, well, I have to give in, don't I? Even if I'm exasperated, and even if she probably just wants me to do the homework for her.

I can already see the future: more tutoring sessions, more of this, "Oh, Suguru-nii, you're the best!" I probably sigh internally, smile slightly...

So, let's draft a few responses. Hmmm…

*   "調子いいんだから" (You're so full of it / smooth talker) – that hits the mark.
*   "どうせまた次も泣きついてくるんでしょ" (You're just gonna come crying to me next time anyway) – Yeah, I can already see the future again.
*   "……まあ、いいけど" (……Well, fine by me) – Reluctant acceptance, because...well, I do care about her grades.
*   "分からないところがあったら、早めに言いなよ。ギリギリは面倒だから" (If there's something you don't get, tell me early. Doing it at the last minute is annoying) - Gotta set some boundaries.

And now…“Suguru might make a good teacher in the future, you know?” Oh, the flattery! She’s playing me like a cheap violin. A teacher? Me? Dealing with *her* all day? And with *Satoru*? No thanks. Though...it does have a certain...ring to it when she says it.

She's laying it on thick, hoping I'll do her homework again. I see right through it. But… (sigh) …I’ll let her have this one.
